title: Protein Interaction Analysis of KaiC3 with Various Kai Homologs via Yeast Two-Hybrid Experiments
author: Anika Wiegard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wcnfave

steps.title: Prepare Media and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary agar plates and stock solutions for yeast selection.

substeps.instruction: Prepare CSM -Leu -Trp agar (complete supplement mixture lacking leucine and tryptophan).
Prepare CSM -Leu -Trp -His agar (complete supplement mixture lacking leucine, tryptophan, and histidine).

steps.title: Transform Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Transform yeast cells and select for successful transformants.

substeps.instruction: Perform transformation according to manufacturer's guidelines using the Frozen-EZ Yeast Transformation II Kit (Zymo Research).
Select transformed cells on CSM -Leu -Trp agar at 30 °C for 3–4 days.

steps.title: Determine Optimal 3-AT Concentration
steps.instruction: Identify the lowest concentration of 3-AT that allows only small (<1-mm) colonies to grow after 3-4 days.

substeps.instruction: Prepare interaction plates (CSM -Leu -Trp -His + 3-AT) using various concentrations of 3-AT: 0 mM, 3 mM, 6.25 mM, 12.5 mM, 25 mM, and 50 mM.
Allow agar to cool before adding 3-AT, as it is heat sensitive.
Mark and restreak 1-3 formed colonies from the transformation step onto these interaction plates, using a small amount of cells to reduce false positives.

steps.title: Analyze Protein Interaction
steps.instruction: Test for protein interaction using the determined 3-AT concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare control plates (CSM -Leu -Trp) and interaction plates (CSM -Leu -Trp -His + determined concentration of 3-AT).
Restreak 1 colony from the transformation step onto the control plate and then onto the interaction plate to reduce cell amount and false positives.
Evaluate results: Interaction is positive if growth occurs on both the control and interaction plates, provided controls show no growth on the interaction plate.
